en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a townscape with a central square in the foreground, a few small houses, a tree with fencing around it, streetlights, and people standing near the base of the tree. In the background rises a large historic complex with a church-like tower and adjoining buildings on a hill. At the top in red script is the word "Dippoldiswalde." On the left margin there is vertically printed publisher information and a year.
